title: Holiday Moving Calendar for Addis Ababa: Timket, Meskel & Festival Road Closures
excerpt: Plan moves around Ethiopian holidays in Addis: Timket Ketera, Meskel Demera, road closures near Jan Meda and Meskel Square, and when to book movers early.
content:
Why holidays change your move

Major Orthodox festivals bring processions, road closures, and crowd control across Addis Ababa. Moving trucks cannot assume normal routes near celebration sites. Book professional movers before holiday weeks—not on the eve of Ketera or Demera.

Timket (Ethiopian Epiphany)

Timket and Ketera (the eve) draw huge crowds to sites such as Jan Meda, Tirunesh Beijing (Akaki Kaliti), Lemi Kura Arabsa areas, and Hachalu Hundessa Square. Police routinely close approach roads for the duration of festivities—planning alternate routes or rescheduling load-out is often mandatory.

Meskel (Finding of the True Cross)

The Demera bonfire at Meskel Square triggers closures on radiating streets (Bole to Meskel, Mexico area, Ras Hotel corridor, and others) often from mid-morning until programs end. Avoid scheduling cross-city truck legs through central squares that day.

Other busy dates

National holidays, Eid, and large concerts can surprise routes even outside Timket/Meskel. Check city notices the week of your move and share updates with your crew lead—freight timing guide.

Practical planning

  • Confirm closure notices from city police the week of your move.
  • Prefer early-morning loads on non-festival days when freight rules and traffic align.
  • Build buffer for condo lift slots—management may blackout holiday dates.
  • Keep a backup day in your lease negotiation when festivals move on the lunar calendar.

Reschedule without penalty

When public events block a route, Active Movers reschedules with written confirmation—better than idling a truck in a closed corridor. Mention festival risk when you book.
